## 2026-09-22 — Q7.8: Domain-specific access rules — no new role introduced

**Bucket:** [Org-decision]/Human-only for role assignment; [Standard]/
AI-draftable for structure.

**Answer:** 3 access rules, all routing authority through roles other
domains already own (Owning Team Lead, Infrastructure Admin, Data
Engineer, Security/Compliance) rather than inventing a new Workflow/
Process-specific role — a deliberate choice, since this domain moves
changes other domains define rather than owning a new class of
accountable resource owner. WFAR-2 (IaC apply approval) is the first
Access Rule in this framework whose authority depends on which other
domain owns the target resource.

**Status:** Pending explicit review.
